text:
The ordering constraints form two chains: Ivo before Ann before Elif before Gus before Hana, and Finn before Ben before Dev, with Cara immediately after Dev.

Cara and Elif have exactly one slot between them, so their positions differ by 2. Dev is at least in slot 3, and Elif needs two slots after her, so the only block that still fits both chains is Elif in 5, Dev in 6, Cara in 7, Gus in 8, Hana in 9. The first four slots are then Ivo, Finn, Ann, and Ben. Elif–Finn separation forces Finn into 2, and Ben–Ivo separation plus Finn-before-Ben forces Ivo in 1, Ann in 3, and Ben in 4. Every other Dev–Cara placement breaks an ordering or separation constraint.
